reasoning: On the season so far the 76ers are the stronger team; with home court the 76ers start about 13 points better, in a game of about 225 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the 76ers win 85 times in 100, by about 13; most games like this end between 199 and 247 total points.
